chunks: From him, from Abū Jaʿfar, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yūsuf, from Muʿādh ibn Thābit al-Jawharī, from ʿAmr ibn Jumayʿ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
When salat over the deceased had passed him by, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform salat over the قبر.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the funeral salat offered for the deceased
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave over which the salat is performed
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: it passed him by or he missed it

ai.seo_question: Can salat for the deceased be performed at the grave if the funeral prayer was missed?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that if the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم missed the funeral salat for a deceased person, he would pray over the grave afterward. It indicates the legitimacy of offering salat for the deceased at the grave when the funeral prayer was missed.
